snippet.query: What are the best Skype alternatives for business?
snippet.exactText: Skype alternatives for business should replace the work your team actually does: meetings, ordinary phone calls, customer support or mobile calling connected to business software. Start with the service, then choose the application. A familiar chat interface does not establish that a customer can reach your number or that an important call reaches the right person.
